summary: Show the Invoice Payment Term for a Requisition (Subcontractor Invoice)
description: Returns the Invoice Payment Term snapshot for a Requisition (Subcontractor Invoice).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Requisition (Subcontractor Invoice)

data.description: Per-invoice snapshot of the payment term assigned to the commitment at invoice submission. The snapshotted term values are fixed at submission, so later changes to the company payment term do not a...

id.description: Unique identifier for the invoice payment term

company_id.description: Company ID that owns this invoice payment term

project_id.description: Project ID that owns this invoice payment term

requisition_id.description: ID of the requisition (subcontractor invoice) this payment term applies to

payment_term_id.description: Identifier of the company-level payment term

payment_term_name.description: Name of the company-level payment term

payment_term_type.description: Type of payment term captured in the snapshot

payment_term_status.description: Current status of the invoice payment term. WAIVED, PAID, DISABLED_MANUAL_PAID, and DISABLED_PARTIALLY_PAID are terminal.

net_days.description: Number of days after the qualifying event that payment is due

discount_valid_days.description: Number of days the discount remains valid after invoice submission

discount_day_of_month.description: Day of the month the discount expires, for DISCOUNT_TERMS payment terms

auto_expire_discount.description: Whether the discount automatically expires once the due date passes

discount_amount.description: Calculated discount amount for this invoice

due_date.description: Date the invoice payment is due under this payment term

created_at.description: Timestamp when the invoice payment term was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the invoice payment term was last updated
